import struct, sys

f=open('/app/alpine.iso','rb')
SIZE=2048
# find primary volume descriptor
pvd=None
for i in range(16,32):
    f.seek(i*SIZE)
    d=f.read(SIZE)
    if d[1:6]==b'CD001':
        if d[0]==1: pvd=d; break
if not pvd: raise SystemExit('no pvd')
root=pvd[156:190]
def rec_len(r): return r[0]
def read_dir(rec):
    extent=struct.unpack('<I',rec[2:6])[0]
    length=struct.unpack('<I',rec[10:14])[0]
    data=b''
    f.seek(extent*SIZE)
    data=f.read(length)
    out=[]
    i=0
    while i<len(data):
        l=data[i]
        if l==0:
            i=(i//SIZE+1)*SIZE
            continue
        r=data[i:i+l]
        namelen=r[32]
        name=r[33:33+namelen]
        try: name=name.decode('ascii')
        except: name=repr(name)
        out.append((name, r, r[25]&2))
        i+=l
    return out
def walk(rec, path=''):
    for name,r,isdir in read_dir(rec):
        if name in ('\x00','\x01') or name.endswith('\x00') or name.endswith('\x01'): continue
        n=name.split(';')[0]
        p=path+'/'+n
        yield p, r, isdir
        if isdir and n not in ('.','..'):
            # find . record child to recurse
            pass
# need recursive using extent directly
def walk2(extent,length,path=''):
    f.seek(extent*SIZE); data=f.read(length)
    i=0
    while i<len(data):
        l=data[i]
        if l==0:
            i=(i//SIZE+1)*SIZE
            if i>=len(data): break
            continue
        r=data[i:i+l]
        namelen=r[32]; name=r[33:33+namelen]
        try: name=name.decode('ascii')
        except: name='?'
        if name not in ('\x00','\x01'):
            n=name.split(';')[0]
            ex=struct.unpack('<I',r[2:6])[0]; ln=struct.unpack('<I',r[10:14])[0]
            isdir=bool(r[25]&2)
            p=path+'/'+n
            yield p,ex,ln,isdir
            if isdir:
                yield from walk2(ex,ln,p)
        i+=l
root_ex=struct.unpack('<I',root[2:6])[0]; root_ln=struct.unpack('<I',root[10:14])[0]
items=list(walk2(root_ex,root_ln))
for p,ex,ln,isdir in items:
    if p.startswith('/boot') or 'vmlinuz' in p.lower() or 'initram' in p.lower() or p.startswith('/apks'):
        print(('D' if isdir else 'F'), ln, p)

        r=data[i:i+l]; namelen=r[32]; name=r[33:33+namelen].decode('ascii','replace')

            isdir=bool(r[25]&2); p=path+'/'+n
            yield p,ex,ln,isdir
            if isdir: yield from walk2(ex,ln,p)

import socket,time,sys,os
sock=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
sock.connect('/tmp/alpine-serial.sock')
sock.setblocking(False)
buf=b''
def read_until(patterns,timeout=600,log=None):
    global buf
    if isinstance(patterns,bytes): patterns=[patterns]
    end=time.time()+timeout
    while time.time()<end:
        try:
            d=sock.recv(65536)
            if not d:
                time.sleep(0.1); continue
            buf+=d
            if log:
                with open(log,'ab') as f: f.write(d)
            for p in patterns:
                if p in buf:
                    return p
        except BlockingIOError:
            time.sleep(0.1)
        except Exception as e:
            raise
    raise TimeoutError('timeout, buf tail: %r' % buf[-500:])
def send(x):
    if isinstance(x,str): x=x.encode()
    sock.sendall(x)
def run(cmd,timeout=600,marker=None):
    global buf
    if marker is None: marker='__CMD_DONE_%d__'%int(time.time()*1000)
    full='%s; echo %s:$?\n'%(cmd,marker)
    print('>>>',cmd,flush=True)
    send(full)
    read_until(marker.encode()+b':',timeout)
    # read remaining line + prompt
    time.sleep(0.3)
    try:
        while True:
            d=sock.recv(65536)
            if not d: break
            buf+=d
    except BlockingIOError: pass
    text=buf.decode('utf-8','replace')
    print(text[-3000:],flush=True)
    buf=b''
    return text
if __name__=='__main__':
    log='/tmp/console.log'
    open(log,'wb').close()
    print('waiting for login...',flush=True)
    read_until(b'login:',300,log)
    print('got login prompt',flush=True)
    send('root\n')
    read_until(b'# ',120,log)
    print('logged in',flush=True)
    run('cat /etc/alpine-release; cat /etc/apk/repositories; ls /media; ls /media/cdrom 2>/dev/null | head')
    run('ip addr; ip route')
